title: Tokyo Stock Exchange
representedDate: Standing 1988 complex, with the active public entrance as shown in December 2025.
geometryBasis: The named footprint and two mapped building parts match the current street frontage. The PLATEAU geometry excerpt establishes the silhouette, parapet and rooftop enclosures, and major setbacks.
sectionBasis: Original creator photographs distinguish the tall granite street portal, set-back glazing, articulated canopy, darker side bands and upper office windows. The architect records 78.8 m maximum height and granite facing.
limitations: Fine window placement, roof hardware and cantilever details are estimated from the exterior originals and measured massing. The local numerical model was aligned to the project ground datum and the documented 78.8 m height. Foundation and entrance steps are fitted to source terrain.
The street facade is represented as a standing exterior. Interiors, commercial signs and adjoining unrelated structures sit outside the scope.
